narrative.overview:
The page is a station hall under its departure board. Across the top hangs one board housing. Its left half holds the app icon, OCHRE, the line, one sentence, and the mustard download with its version, size, macOS floor and licence. Its right half is a live die-map pane: an M5 PRO head on flaps, Super and Performance cores as split-flap tiles that flip and heat with load, CPU temperature flaps, and 20 GPU bars. The pane is labelled "Demo data". Below the board, a departures board lists the app's tabs (Overview, CPU, Memory, Network, Disk), each row with a pictogram, a flap-lettered name, what the tab shows, and its refresh rate. After that come the lightweight, native and private strip, the real app screenshots, "Also on board", and an install block set in a second housing that carries the second download.

Everything is graphite: matte charcoal housings lit from the top left, darker panes set into them, and flap tiles with a hairline split across the middle. Lettering is warm off-white. Colour on the board means heat and nothing else. The one exception is the download, which is mustard.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite ground (`ground`) with charcoal board housings (22u radius, top-left light falloff) and inset panes.
Split-flap tiles everywhere data appears. Each tile has a 1px dark split line across its middle.
Barlow Semi Condensed for the brand name and the numerals on tiles. Commissioner for prose. IBM Plex Mono for every flap letter and every station caption.
Heat scale ported from the app (amber, then ember, then red). Cold tiles stay graphite.
Mustard marks the primary action only.
One unit, `--u = 100vw / 1536` on desktop and `100vw / 620` under 63.99rem, with px overrides for every text and flap size on mobile.
One motion: the demo board ticks every 2 s and changed tiles flip.

rules.name: The Colour Is Heat Rule
rules.body: On the board and the departures, chromatic colour appears only where a core, a GPU or a reading is under load, and only through `heatColor()`. Labels, rows, pictograms, section heads and the temperature flaps stay graphite and off-white.

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: Mustard fills the download and nothing else on the page surface. The focus ring and the selection highlight are the only other places it appears, and both are transient interaction states.

rules.name: The Digits-Only Display Rule
rules.body: Barlow Semi Condensed sets only the Latin brand name and numerals. It has no Cyrillic, so any word that can be Russian goes on Plex Mono flaps or in Commissioner.

rules.name: The Flap Letter Rule
rules.body: Words on the board (chip name, cluster labels, tab names, tab descriptions, refresh units, screenshot and "on board" titles) are set one letter per flap in Plex Mono. Prose is never set on flaps longer than a single short line.

rules.name: The Lit Housing Rule
rules.body: Housings always use the 160° light-falloff gradient, never a flat fill, and they are the only surfaces that drop a shadow onto the ground.

rules.name: The Split Line Rule
rules.body: Every flap and tile carries a 1px black split at 50% height (45% opacity on tiles, 22% to 40% on letter flaps). Empty flap seams on the rows are drawn as repeating 1u dark lines every 35.5u.

dos: **Do** size in `--u` on desktop and switch to px under 63.99rem for every text, flap and control.
**Do** colour load only through `heatColor()` and `tileInk()` from `board.ts`, and keep cold tiles on `flap`.
**Do** light a GPU bar count proportional to load (`gpuLit`), with one shared heat colour.
**Do** put words on the board on Plex Mono flaps with the visually hidden text alongside.
**Do** label demo data as demo, on the pane and in its hidden caption.
**Do** paint housings with the 160° light-falloff gradient and inset panes into them.
**Do** keep the flip at 130 + 130 ms on a 2 s tick, paused off screen and absent under reduced motion.
**Do** source every raster from the app repo with provenance (`src/assets/products/ochre/SOURCE.json`, `assets/plates/ochre-icon.png.json`).
donts: **Don't** use heat colours on labels, rows, pictograms, headings or any decoration.
**Don't** use mustard as a surface, text colour or marker anywhere but the download (focus ring and selection excepted).
**Don't** set Russian words in Barlow Semi Condensed.
**Don't** paint a GPU bar by its index or across a multi-colour gradient. All lit bars share the overall load's heat.
**Don't** invent claims or tab descriptions. Copy comes from the app's README (ru/en) and its tab names.
**Don't** apply hub materials (board fibre, Hub Display, ink mask, signal orange) here.
